purpose: Input design for an ARC-inspired teaching/research transport model; not an ARC reproduction or qualified material specification.

source_design.paper: Sorbom et al., ARC: A compact, high-field, fusion nuclear science facility and demonstration power plant with demountable magnets
source_design.note: ARC neutronics are a simplified axisymmetric MCNP design calculation; several first-wall/divertor designs were explicitly open-ended.

material_basis.isotope_policy: Preserve final nuclide atom fractions used in transport and source recipe/provenance. Elemental natural-abundance expansion is a declared assumption, not implicit identity.
material_basis.geometry_policy: Material identities are distinct from geometric dimensions. The current FARIS two-allocation radial envelope does not establish ARC wall/channel/multiplier layer thicknesses or a detailed ARC radial build.
material_basis.temperature_policy: Record physical material temperature and nuclear-data temperature separately; no silent use of 293.6 K data for hot materials.

regions.candidate: stoichiometric Li2BeF4 (2 LiF : 1 BeF2 molar), liquid

composition.status: Li enrichment and salt formula are ARC-derived; Be9-only/F19-only representation remains a declared implementation assumption until isotope conventions are selected.

bulk_temperature_K.source: ARC thermal analysis; peak reported as less than 1000 K

reported_density.limitation: The paper does not document the density value's exact isotope/composition basis. Do not silently assign as a measured density for 90%-Li6 salt.

alternate_measured_density_fit.uncertainty_note: Reported fit parameter uncertainties are standard errors; measurement density standard uncertainty and composition basis apply to that near-natural lithium sample, not ARC enriched salt.

transport_modes.status: candidate after full composition inventory/data validation; not a hot operating case

transport_modes.status: blocked pending supported and justified hot data for every selected nuclide and response
transport_modes.limitation: ARC's temperatures are design assumptions/predictions, not validated FARIS conditions.

source_specification_required.pair_comparison_rule: Use an identical fully identified source in both variants. Do not call 14.1 MeV monoenergetic/isotropic source an ARC recreation without the original MCNP source specification.

response_scope.tritium_breeding: score Li-6 and Li-7 tritium production responses with verified reaction/Q-value and normalization behavior; ARC TBR >= 1.1 is not a transferable acceptance criterion.
response_scope.fast_neutron_exposure: define energy cutoff, tally volume/averaging, source normalization and operating history; does not alone predict magnet life.
response_scope.nuclear_heating: Use coupled neutron-photon treatment and documented deposited-energy response for total nuclear heating, or report total heating unavailable. Photoatomic file presence alone is insufficient. ARC explicitly counted both neutron and photon heating.
